{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Correct assay_batch B: convert µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute the mean
mean_value = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'].mean()

# Print the exact number that will be submitted
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_value}")

# Return it for submission
mean_value"}
